== Summary ==
Tournaments Coordinator [[Bruce Umene]] does the macarena while [[Aron Eisenberg]] signs. Photo: Decipher. See [[DecipherCon 1999]], [[1999 Decipher World Championship]], [[DecipherCon 1999 photographs]].

Who is where: [[Bruce Umene]] is the man in glasses at far left, pointing his finger. [[Aron Eisenberg]] is seated at the table, signing. [[Jim Colson]], [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]] Gold 5, stands left of centre in a black shirt with a name badge.

Identification: Decipher's fri30 caption names Umene and Eisenberg. Umene's place in the frame and Colson: Bill Bisco, 25 October 2026.
